titleEn: Review customer InstaPay receipts: confirm / reject / refund

ar: العميل رفع ايصال انستاباي اتأكد منه ازاي؟
en: How do I confirm an InstaPay receipt?

edgeCases: Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
Team member lacking the permission gets 403: assistant states who can do it (store owner) instead of retrying
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: No assistant receipt reader for merchant-side receipts (reader exists for Ebda's own InstaPay)
assistantNote: merchant decides; assistant may summarise receipt data but never confirm silently
